name: markup inside backticks in what a renderer reads as a table
why: A GFM table splits a row into cells before any inline is read, so the backticks on the first line never pair and the tag between them is a real element. Every line's backticks pair within that line, so a rule that reasons line by line finds nothing wrong at all.

rows.headline: protection worked by surprise
